steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: You're gonna take out a loan from the bank? Have you lost your mind?

steps.name: Irritable Woman
steps.text: What's your plan then, wise guy? How do you reckon we get to Trimounts in just a few days? This clinical trial is Tibby's last chance!

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: I'll think of some other way...

steps.name: Irritable Woman
steps.text: What other way? No way we're getting that kinda money without a loan!

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: ...R-Right! Didn't we get health insurance for Tibby before? That should cover serious illness!

steps.name: Irritable Woman
steps.text: What the hell do you think I was doing all day yesterday? I went to the bank to cash out on the insurance, but Tibby's illness wasn't covered at all!

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: I'm begging you, please, let's not jump straight to taking out a loan, okay?

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Just think about your sister. She only took a small loan, but it ruined her life. Remember how much she suffered until finally...

steps.name: Irritable Woman
steps.text: Her entire family died on their way to the frontier.

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: So calm down and think this through. There's gotta be another way.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Why do I see this stuff every damn time I come to the bank?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All the more reason for us to be here. And especially for us to attend this so-called 'welcoming party,' Franka.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If we don't witness these things with our own eyes... we'll forever remain left in the dark.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Is Fort Barron going to tow Davistown back onto its original route all by itself?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: This request was made directly by the regional government. The outcome will affect Blacksteel's image and credibility. We'll give this mission our all.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Good to hear. We appreciate it.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All part of the job.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Would the two of you like beer or champagne? We're out in the sticks, so you may find our selection rather unsatisfactory. All I ask is that you bear with us.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...Unsatisfactory? You're too humble.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Take a look, Captain. This beer has no label on the bottle, but it's just as good as any niche brand from a craft brewery. The champagne's also high-end... I must say, excellent taste.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: It's important to keep some luxury items on hand when you're stationed in a difficult area. We do have to keep up morale, after all.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Is cranking up the thermostat so high that people want to crack open an ice-cold beer also part of keeping up morale?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: ...Well, yes, as you've noted we do have a separate backup energy supply, which includes heating and electricity.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Funny how no one else seems to have this backup system.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: That would be due to the prescience of our first president during the early planning and development phases. An important safety consideration.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: The services provided by a financial institution are somewhat unique. Large amounts of money flow in and out, and be it systems or resources, it's always better to be more self-reliant.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: Presumably, Blacksteel built their safe house here in Davistown out of the very same concerns. Isn't that right, Miss Franka?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh... I'm fine with just a glass of water. I'll leave the beer for your employees. To keep up morale.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We've sent people back to Blacksteel HQ to report the repair status of Davistown's power plant.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: As the plant has not been restored to a state where it can support navigation, HQ will naturally have to formulate a new solution.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: We are very appreciative of your company's contributions to our town.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: However, until a solution is in place, we do have one humble request.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: ...What sort of request?

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: We were hoping you could help maintain law and order here.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: I'm sure you've already encountered bandits on the town's outskirts. They've caused us a substantial amount of damage. Even more troubling is the fact that...

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: ...a number of people living here are, to put it nicely, bandits themselves. To put it less nicely, they're the bandits' reserve army.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: We would be very grateful if you could clear them out of Davistown. Here's a list of names—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Over the past few days, we've sent personnel to conduct security operations around the plate's perimeter. Based on their reports, I have little reason to believe that so many dangerous elements are operating here.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: There are people here with no money, yet are unwilling to put in the work to pay back their debts. How can you guarantee they won't resort to more... desperate measures down the line?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: ...If you insist. We'll look into it.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: You'll 'look into it'? Why must you verify it yourselves? You can't take us at our word?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: If our trust is so fragile that it's broken just by double-checking a list, then it wasn't worth much to begin with.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: ...Do as you please, then.

steps.name: Bank Manager
steps.text: But if you really want to check things, be sure to be thorough.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How'd it go? Any developments on your end?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Mm. The target's already entered visual range... Seems like he's not the only one here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is he working with someone?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: ...Seems to be someone from the plate.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Woodrow, sir, is that... possible?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Anything's possible. When the government here collapsed, some young'uns with too much time on their hands formed gangs and started making trouble all over the place.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But... what do they hope to accomplish by colluding with the bandits out in the barrens?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Jessica, they're about to disperse... Should we arrest them?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What do you think, Woodrow?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Wait and see. Now's not the time.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Then, umm... Don't do anything for now. Record where they showed up, and contact me if they show up here again.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Alright, no problem.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: One sec. Which direction did the bandits go? I'm gonna follow 'em and have a look.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: They went southeast.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Should I come with you?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Nah, I can handle this myself.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Head back for now.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Er, Jessica... is that gentleman someone from the plate?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Umm, he's been investigating these bandits on his own, so he should be able to help us out.

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I... I'm not sure how to break this to you, but I feel like you need a reminder. Getting cozy with the locals rarely works out well.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wh-Why's that?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Places like Davistown don't just go on like normal after getting reclaimed by the government. They've always got other plans on the docket, and when the time comes, the businesses, the infrastructure... even the residents will be replaced.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Replaced? Then, what happens to the original residents? Where do they go?

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I don't know how Blacksteel usually handles it, but with my last employer, we were only responsible for kicking them out. What happened afterwards was none of our business.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: How could they not care?! That's totally illegal! How could they just drive out all the locals?!

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: *sigh*... There's always an excuse when it comes to places like this on the verge of bankruptcy. Like, bad debts, tax investigations, security concerns...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Debts...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Not just me. Everyone left here is in debt. *sigh*... How do I put this? Well, I'll just give it to you straight.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: You asked about a guy who walked out into the snowfield earlier, right? It's probably 'cause of his debts... That kinda stuff happens all the time here. After being forced into bankruptcy, he had no choice but to...

steps.name: Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Jessica? Hey, Jessica! What's gotten into you?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I'm heading back first.

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: ...that stubborn, good-for-nothing father of yours... starting today...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: ...what nonsense are you spewing...

steps.name: Distant Voice
steps.text: ...let go of me...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is that a child's voice?!

steps.name: Vicious Gangster
steps.text: This brat sure knows how to whine. Guess he needs a gag and a good beating before he'll learn to follow us obediently—

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Stop right there! Let go of him!

steps.name: Dopey Gangster
steps.text: And why should I? Who the hell are you?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Help! They're trying to kidnap me!

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Don't make me repeat myself—let go of the kid!

steps.name: Dopey Gangster
steps.text: His father's in so much debt that even selling the boy off wouldn't pay it all back. So what if we kidnap him?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Debt? Are you here to collect debts? Wait, don't tell me you're working for the bank?!

steps.name: Vicious Gangster
steps.text: ...Mind your own damn business. Now get outta here!

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Help! Someone, save me—

steps.name: Vicious Gangster
steps.text: Shut your damn mouth—

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Urgh... *cough*...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Last warning—let the kid go, and don't make any rash moves. Otherwise, my next bullet won't just be a warning shot!

steps.name: Vicious Gangster
steps.text: ...Tch, playing hardball, huh?

steps.name: Vicious Gangster
steps.text: Let's get out of here. No point risking our lives over this damn brat.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What's your name? Where do you live? I can take you back home.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: I'm Benny... And you can just leave me at the diner. My dad's there every night, so I can wait for him there.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Is your dad... Leone Theremin?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: How'd you know?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I've met him. Oh right, those two people back there were talking about his debt... Were they debt collectors sent by the bank?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Umm... At first, it was just collection letters. Then they started sending people to our house to cause trouble, and my dad chased them out. And this time, the bank probably wanted to use me to force him to pay them back.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But that's clearly a crime...

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Who's gonna stop them? There's no police here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Can you show me your dad's bills? I might be able to help.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: You... Are you serious? His bills are something awful...

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: I took a gander and... there ain't a whole lot more we can do for the ol' tower this time around.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I already told you, that Laura girl did a great job tidying things up and fixing what could be fixed. But you just had to come out here yourself.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Just wanted to see if there's anything Blacksteel missed, that we could handle.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: What, you think they're gonna pay off your loans if you work overtime?

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ...I can dream, can't I?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: You're better off praying for goldbacks to fall from the sky.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I told you, your only lifeline at this point is selling off all the shares you've got in the mine.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I know you blew your life savings and took out loans to get those shares, but—

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: Hell no.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Then lemme ask you, how much debt is that payment from Blacksteel even gonna clear? I reckon it's nowhere close to even paying off the interest.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: How about this, then? Help me with the plant maintenance. We'll be able to keep it running off the fuel that Blacksteel brought.

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: I also happen to have a few days off. I'll pay you with the money Blacksteel gave me, and that'll buy you some time with the bank, at least.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: No Miles, you earned that money. Besides, how's that any different from just giving it away?

steps.name: Miles
steps.text: Not like this, not like that, sounds to me like you got an excuse to say no to everything. It ain't gonna matter when you're bankrupt and the bank's stealing the shirt off your back.

steps.name: Leone
steps.text: ...There's gotta be a way.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Beer, electricity, security deposit... Everything looks fine, and it's within the range of what I can cover...

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: What you can cover...? Are you gonna pay off Leone's debt?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If possible, yes.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Dad's more afraid of owing favors than anything else. When my brother passed away, he couldn't even afford a funeral. And when people offered to lend him money, he said he didn't wanna be treated like a beggar.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: So he ended up following Uncle Woodrow around outside. Logging, hunting, fincatching... He worked so hard those two months that when he came back his fingers were deformed.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: And how much money did he make from all that?

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: About two or three thousand?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...He'll never pay back his debts like that.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Wait, what... He's still one of the mine's shareholders?!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Forget it. After the mine shut down, he's had to pay all kinds of fuel fees, vacancy fees, and land management fees just to keep his shares... and he borrows piles of money from the bank every year to do it.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Th-That's practically an open wound they're bleeding him dry with. Even if I came in to help him, there's no way he'd be able to pay it off...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: If he doesn't dump those shares, he's going to have nothing left.

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: Not happening. Dad loves that mine more than anything. He'd never dump those shares, even if we both got sent to the frontier for hard labor.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Benny, don't talk about your father like that.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: By the way, Jessica, what's gotten into you all of a sudden? Is something wrong? Leone's still a shareholder in the mine, so the bank's not likely to make him declare bankruptcy anytime soon.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I saw someone try to kidnap Benny today... To force Leone to pay off his debts.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Kidnapping?!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: They can go after Leone all they want, but to try to kidnap a teenage boy... Have they no shame?!

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Benny, you're staying with me for now. When Leone finds out his kid's missing, I'll give him a piece of my mind and ask him what the hell he's doing as a father!

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: No... Don't tell him. I don't want him to worry.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: We've gone way past 'making him worry.' He needs to know damn well the consequences of what he's doing!

steps.name: Benny
steps.text: I... I still need to go home.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Gah... How can such a stubborn asshole have a kid as sweet as you?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: In any case, if he's willing to sell his shares, then that—combined with some tax rebates and preferential policies he never noticed—should be enough to cover the debt.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: You sure?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I... I can practically guarantee it.

steps.name: Helena
steps.text: Alright. Sounds like he just needs a good reminder to stop messing around.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: It's finally over...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: So, why is the main switch for the entire building located just a hundred steps from the front entrance? Is this also some great prescience from the bank's founder?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: ...That's ridiculous.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: ...It doesn't make a lick of sense.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: One step, two steps, three steps... There's a desk seven paces out, then make a left turn...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: ...Twenty-four, twenty-five, twenty-six... Oops, bumped into the lamp.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Fifty-seven, fifty-eight, fifty-nine...

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: One hundred.

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Excuse me.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: ...Can I help you?

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Is the bank still open? I... I'd like to take out a loan—

steps.name: Irritable Woman
steps.text: Sylvia? Get over here Sylvia, quick. I'd like to borrow some money from the bank. Can I count on you to get me a slightly better interest rate? Oh, I should never have been so mean to you...

steps.name: Irritable Woman
steps.text: What... What are you doing here?

steps.name: Anxious Man
steps.text: Wait, you... What are you doing here?

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: I'm sorry, you two, but we're not open for business today.
Seeing the couple stare at each other in silence, Sylvia bows her head and steps away from the bank's gates.
The whole way back, the thick darkness that even the street lights do not penetrate lingers with her, caressing her neck affectionately.
Since her mother passed away, she's left work the same way every day, just like this.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: ...One thousand eight hundred seventy-seven, one thousand eight hundred seventy-eight. And, home.

steps.name: Sylvia
steps.text: Mom, I'm home.
She waits for a long time, but only silence greets her back.
After a moment, she takes out her keys, opens the door, wipes the soles of her shoes on the doormat, and leaves the suffocating darkness in the street behind her.
